headline: Texas Track & Field · Pole Vault

school.name: The University of Texas at Austin

bio.short: Sam Abati is a Texas pole vaulter from San Antonio and the 2024 UIL 6A state champion. He ranks No. 6 indoors and tied No. 8 outdoors on the Longhorns' all-time lists. A Corporate Communication major, he was a 2026 Project Manager Intern at Feniex Industries.
long: Sam Abati raises the bar steadily. As a sophomore in 2026 he won the Leonard Hilton Memorial, set an indoor best of 5.46m to place eighth at the SEC Indoor Championships, then cleared 5.50m (18-0.50) at the Tom Jones Memorial and matched it to finish fifth at the SEC Outdoor Championships. Those marks make him the No. 6 indoor and tied No. 8 outdoor pole vaulter in Texas history. Before college he won the 2024 UIL 6A state title and left Ronald Reagan High School holding the San Antonio-area record of 17-6.

Abati grew up in San Antonio and lettered all four years in track at Reagan. After finishing state runner-up as a junior, he set two goals for his senior season, the school record and a state title, and achieved both. Now a junior at Texas studying Corporate Communication, he has twice made the USTFCCCA All-Academic Team and earned SEC Academic Honor Roll recognition. He describes himself as proactive, with a mindset "all about growth and action", and away from the vault pit he fishes and golfs.

Pole vault rewards people who break a big goal into small, repeatable pieces: the approach, the plant, the takeoff, the adjustment for the next attempt. Abati brought that habit to Feniex Industries, the Austin manufacturer of emergency-vehicle lighting and electronics, as a 2026 Project Manager Intern. He supported cross-functional projects by keeping schedules, status updates and documentation clear for the people relying on them. He communicates plainly, prepares thoroughly and treats every attempt as information for the next one.
